correctness.rationale: Projection onto any single row of a 3x3 code with cover distance >=3 is injective, proving |C|<=8 for arbitrary nonlinear codes; equality forces all three row and column projections to be bijective. König matching theorem identifies cover weight 3 with a perfect matching in the 3x3 support graph. Independently enumerated all 512 binary matrices, obtaining cover histogram 1,33,231,247; built the 247-vertex compatibility graph and enumerated all size-seven cliques extending zero, obtaining exactly 7622. Addition-closure found 1718 linear normalized codes, giving 487808 total labeled, 109952 affine, 377856 nonlinear by eight-point incidence. Independently generated row/column S3, transpose and normalized translation actions and obtained exactly 59 orbits with labeled orbit-size distribution 128:1,768:2,1152:2,2304:8,3072:1,4608:21,6144:1,9216:9,18432:13,36864:1. This is a finite exhaustive proof of the specified nine-bit universe, not a claim for larger parameters.
